title: Primary calibrated effect
alt_text: Primary Sanskrit minus Turkish calibrated-percentile effect is 0.000; the 95 percent interval is also 0.000 to 0.000 and crosses the no-effect line.

title: Language score distributions

title: Lexicon-subsample stability
alt_text: All 20 lexicon subsamples have median Sanskrit minus Turkish calibrated-percentile difference 0.000, so every point lies on the no-effect line.
encoding: Numbered black circles connected by a solid line against a dashed zero line.
